section_summary.extract_value: This section (3.4) examines the construct and incremental validity of BAS-2 scores using gender-stratified analyses. In women, body appreciation was significantly and negatively associated with BMI, while in men this association did not reach significance. Hierarchical regression analyses demonstrated that BAS-2 scores provided incremental validity in predicting subjective happiness beyond other appearance-related variables for both genders.
